phrases.title: Sunflower Keys — Three low colors make a nine-note answer
rows: Three places for each low color
notes: Nine distinct seeds use only the three lowest colors. Drawn order makes three short rising rounds; the two higher colors never sound.
The same nine seeds now keep each color together. Changing drawn order changes the phrase, not the set of places or its three pitches.
The first round rises near the center, the outer round rises next, and the middle round returns in reverse. Planting is silent; choose Drawn to hear that order.
phrases.facts: Source rule in app.js: pitch depends on index modulo five, not distance from center. Each list contains the same nine distinct integers; residue counts are 3,3,3,0,0. Preserve current root/register/tempo/voice/play-order/reverse/bounce.
